snapshot: 2026 NFL Week 10 — official injury report and club depth charts (pilot: 6 clubs)
method: Pages were read with the agent's page-fetch tool from the official domains; the shell in this sandbox cannot reach them (TLS handshake refused by the egress allowlist). The CSV files below are agent transcriptions of the rendered pages, not byte-exact crawls. Every row carries the page URL it was transcribed from. Transcription was checked by row counts per club, by a name-by-name re-read of each table, and by re-fetching the injury page after the transcription (same rows).

limitations: Club depth charts are published by the clubs, and several clubs explicitly label them UNOFFICIAL (NE, DET, KC).
Depth charts are a projection, not a starting lineup; official inactives and snap counts are published later.
The NFL report is a practice-participation report; a blank game status means no game designation was published at snapshot time.
Transcription is an agent-mediated step; a byte-exact archived crawl is required before this is treated as archival evidence.
